name: Cala Millor
title: Jet Ski Rental in Cala Millor, Mallorca | JetExperience Baleares
description: Rent a jet ski in Cala Millor, Mallorca. Direct departure from Costa de los Pinos. Modern Sea-Doo, life jacket included. Easy booking via WhatsApp.
h1: Jet Ski Rental in Cala Millor, Mallorca
intro1: Cala Millor is one of the most popular tourist destinations on the east coast of Mallorca, with over 1.5 km of golden sandy beach. Its calm, shallow waters make it the perfect setting to enjoy a jet ski experience, whether it's your first time or you're already experienced.
intro2: From our base in Costa de los Pinos, we deliver directly to your beach on our Sea-Doo. All you need is a nautical licence and the desire to enjoy the Mediterranean.
highlight: Ride along 1.5 km of golden beach in calm, drift-free waters.
features: Calm waters, ideal for beginners with a nautical licence
1.5 km beach with golden sand and visible seabed

faq.q: Where does the jet ski depart from in Cala Millor?
faq.a: Our base is at Avenida del Pinar 43, Costa de los Pinos, less than 1 km from Cala Millor beach. We can also deliver directly to the beach if you prefer.

faq.q: Are the waters of Cala Millor suitable for beginners?
faq.a: Yes. Cala Millor has calm, well-protected waters, ideal for first-time riders. A nautical licence is always mandatory, and a safety briefing is included.

h1: Jet Ski Rental in Cala Bona, Mallorca

intro2: Our base in Costa de los Pinos is less than 5 minutes away by water, making Cala Bona one of the most convenient starting points for your experience.
highlight: Intimate natural harbour with blue waters and views of the Serra de Llevant.
features: More intimate and less crowded than Cala Millor
1 km from our base — we arrive in minutes

faq.q: Can I book the jet ski directly in Cala Bona?
faq.a: Yes. Contact us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm the exact meeting point in Cala Bona. The service includes drop-off and pick-up at the agreed location.

faq.q: How long does it take to reach Cala Bona from your base?
faq.a: Our base is less than 1 km from Cala Bona. We confirm the meeting time when you book and arrive punctually.

name: Porto Cristo
title: Jet Ski Rental in Porto Cristo, Mallorca | JetExperience Baleares
description: Jet ski route to Porto Cristo from Costa de los Pinos. ~12 km of unspoilt coastline, hidden coves and cliffs. Our most adventurous experience. Book via WhatsApp.
h1: Jet Ski Rental in Porto Cristo, Mallorca
intro1: Porto Cristo is one of Mallorca's most spectacular natural harbours, world-famous for the Coves del Drach. Riding a jet ski to Porto Cristo is our most adventurous route: approximately 12 km of unspoilt coastline with hidden coves and dramatic cliffs.
intro2: This route is available with the Special 2-hour Pack and is perfect for those with experience who want to explore Mallorca's east coast in depth. Check availability via WhatsApp.
highlight: Our most spectacular route: ~12 km of unspoilt coastline to the natural harbour of Porto Cristo.
features: ~12 km route with virgin coves and cliffs
Spectacular natural harbour at the end of the journey

faq.q: Can we reach Porto Cristo by jet ski?
faq.a: Yes, it's our longest route. Available with the Special 2-hour Pack. Previous experience and good sea conditions recommended. Check availability.

faq.q: How long does the route to Porto Cristo take?
faq.a: Approximately 2 hours return at a comfortable pace, with stops to enjoy the scenery. That's why we recommend the 2-hour pack.
